topic: SAA African cell <21,795 nT — verify WIN-005 cross-ref patch (decay-figure disambiguation) fits
our_argument_summary: WIN-035 (verdict: Std Model Explains): the SAA African-cell threshold of 21,795 nT is non-discriminating — both WMM2025 and the dome extrapolate the same INTERMAGNET/observatory station data, the dome adds no mechanism and no geometric derivation, and the claim is post-hoc (PROS-005 registered 2026-03-06, confirmed 2026-03-12 on WMM2025 data public since late 2024).

dome_code_analysis.calculation_pipeline: No automated monitor.py domain fires for the SAA African-cell WIN; threshold is observational curve-fitting from WIN-005 CHAOS-7 data, not a dome-geometry derivation.
dome_code_analysis.hardcoded_vs_computed: Threshold 21,795 nT is a hardcoded/extrapolated target, not computed from dome parameters.
dome_code_analysis.escape_clauses: None newly observed; verification-class re-review of a cross-ref patch only.

code_analysis_tags.monitoring_evidence: WIN-035 code_analysis.monitoring=none; no monitor.py domain fetches/compares this WIN. Unchanged by the cross-ref patch (data/wins.json WIN-035 code_analysis).
code_analysis_tags.relabels_standard_evidence: Both WMM2025 and dome extrapolate the same station trend; the dome renames standard extrapolation without a distinct numeric prediction (WIN-035 detail_evidence).
code_analysis_tags.post_hoc_evidence: WMM2025/IGRF decay rate public since late 2024; PROS-005 registered 2026-03-06, confirmed 2026-03-12 (WIN-035 detail_evidence/detail_verdict_text).
code_analysis_tags.derives_from_dome_evidence: Threshold derived by extrapolating WIN-005 CHAOS-7 data (23,050->21,880 nT over 2000-2025), explicitly observational curve-fitting, not geometric derivation (WIN-035 detail_evidence).

holes_found.description: Cross-WIN phrasing (in WIN-005, not introduced by this patch): WIN-005 calls the implied 46.8 nT/yr rate (23,050->21,880 nT over 2000-2025) "consistent with the ~28-30 nT/yr multi-decade station figure used in WIN-035". 46.8 is not numerically equal to 28-30; the reconciliation rests entirely on the parenthetical gloss "the same quantity over a faster recent window". A defender could quote "consistent with" out of context. The new WIN-035 cross-ref makes this reconciliation MORE visible (good), but the loose word "consistent" lives in WIN-005.
holes_found.recommendation: Optional, low priority: in WIN-005 (i), reword "consistent with the ~28-30 nT/yr multi-decade station figure" to e.g. "the same metric as the ~28-30 nT/yr multi-decade station figure, measured over a faster recent window". Not a blocker; does not affect WIN-035 verdict.

kernel_of_truth.description: The cross-ref patch is a correct, well-targeted fix. Before it, a reader comparing WIN-035 ("~28-30 nT/yr") against WIN-005 (which surfaces ~47 nT/yr over 2000-2025) could infer an internal contradiction; WIN-035 now explicitly flags both figures and routes the reader to WIN-005 for the three-figure disambiguation (data/wins.json WIN-035 detail_evidence: "see WIN-005 for disambiguation of the three decay figures in the literature, including the accelerating ~47 nT/yr rate over 2000-2025 per CHAOS-7").
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: It does not need to — this is our own cross-ref and it strengthens the review. The substantive WIN-035 verdict (non-discriminating + post-hoc, Std Model Explains) is untouched and still holds: the dome supplies no mechanism and no geometric derivation (data/wins.json WIN-035 detail_verdict_text; WIN-005 detail_evidence on reversed-flux-patch core dynamics).

deeper_analysis: Verification of queue_id 484 (class: verification): decider applied a WIN-005.c4-derived cross-ref to WIN-035 adding a disambiguation parenthetical to the opening sentence. Verified three things. (1) Anchor validity: the build (build-scripts/generate-html.js) renders WIN-005 as id="win005"; href="#win005" is the established in-document cross-ref convention (dozens of existing #winNNN links in wins.json and docs/index.html), and the new link already appears in the built docs/index.html. The link is live, not broken. (2) Content accuracy: WIN-005 genuinely disambiguates three decay figures — (i) minimum-value drop ~28-30 nT/yr multi-decade, accelerating to ~47 nT/yr over 2000-2025 per CHAOS-7; (ii) peak local secular variation ~98 nT/yr; (iii) the dome qualitative-only per-lobe claim. WIN-035 parenthetical ("~47 nT/yr rate over 2000-2025 per CHAOS-7") matches figure (i). (3) Cross-WIN consistency: the patch RESOLVES the latent 28-30-vs-47 tension rather than creating one. Staleness check (git pull --rebase) confirms the cross-ref is still present. The only residual nit is the loose word "consistent" inside WIN-005 (minor hole above), not introduced by this patch. PROP-038 verify-mode handoff was NOT taken because gate (b) fails: the most recent prior review (WIN-035.c2) carries 6 holes, exceeding the <=2 threshold, so this item stayed in curmudgeon scope.

summary_for_decider: Patch fits cleanly. Cross-ref anchor #win005 is valid and already in the built HTML; disambiguation content matches WIN-005; the patch resolves the cross-WIN 28-30-vs-47 nT/yr tension. no_change. queue_id 484 serviced.
